value_props.title: At CIS®, we’re harnessing the power of the global IT community to safeguard public and private organizations against cyber and cyber-enabled threats. Join us.
Join Our Trusted Community of Cyber Defenders, Built by SLTTs, for SLTTs
World-Renowned Best Practices and Expert Communities

main_content.text: Creating Confidence in the Connected World™
At CIS®, we’re harnessing the power of the global IT community to safeguard public and private organizations against cyber and cyber-enabled threats. Join us.
The fourth annual Alan Paller Laureate Program seeks to find and support those focused on improving cybersecurity with a focus on AI, large scale of use, or the "cyber underserved."
Industry solutions for cyber and cyber-enabled threats.
Join Our Trusted Community of Cyber Defenders, Built by SLTTs, for SLTTs
Security isn't a solo fight. The MS-ISAC connects SLTTs to a nationwide community defense network that keeps everyone safer.
World-Renowned Best Practices and Expert Communities
Together, We Can Make a Difference

CIS operates as a mission driven, nonprofit organization dedicated to making the connected world a safer place. Our employees adhere to our Code of Ethics , Leadership Principles , and Code of Conduct , consistent with our collaborative, nonpartisan, vendor-agnostic operating model. These values guide our decisions and actions and build trust in our capabilities, enabling us to achieve our mission.
